title: Camera3D shows incorrect view frustum in the editor viewport when projection_type is set to FRUSTUM
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.4.1.stable 

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6607) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12700H (20 threads)

### Issue description

When using `Camera3D` with `ProjectionType::Frustum`, the visual representation of the camera's view frustum in the editor viewport does not correctly reflect the actual projection parameters. Specifically:

- The viewport shows an incorrect frustum height.
- The `frustum_offset` is not visually represented.
- The rendered output is correct, but the gizmo and viewport visualization are misleading.


### Steps to reproduce

1. Add a `Camera3D` node. Set its projection to `Frustum`. Modify `Size` to 0.1
2. Add a `MeshInstance3D` node. Set `Mesh` to `BoxMesh`. Set position to (-1, 0, -1)
3. Click the Camera3D object and see the preview window.
4. The closest vertices of the BoxMesh appear at the edge of the preview window. However, the camera frustum shown in the viewport suggests a very squashed view that should not be able to see those vertices.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/59e17491-4a72-4f1e-a54f-a90669ff7000)
